notes.title: Spanish Subtitles!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, friends![/h1]

[h1] Spanish subtitles are now available! [/h1] 

Giving attention and care for all of you, we are adding materials in diferente languages. As soon as possible, another options will be available!

If you want to participate by sending your fan translation, we will be happy by sendind to you Amora´s spreadsheet and, after, we can implemente it! It will be a great contribution to your local community, because this experience may be more accessible for all friends.

Thanks for your support!

Hugs,

Jaderson e Tainá
Game e Arte
